record: Source: City of Chicago Data Portal, Contracts (rsxa-ify5), https://data.cityofchicago.org/Administration-Finance/Contracts/rsxa-ify5, read 2026-10-27. Awards and modifications approved 2023-10-27 to 2026-10-27, and contracts whose latest end date falls by 2027-10-27. An award of 0 on a blanket contract depends upon requirements (orders as needed). Negative amounts are modifications that took money out. Award totals are not unit prices. Vendor addresses are not included; "Name withheld" marks a vendor name that does not read as a business.
Trade words: graffiti, pressure washing, power washing, sandblasting. Purchases of goods, fleet upkeep, design and engineering, software, art, grants, leases and redevelopment deals are left out.
